title: 实验 4-8 · 加一个电压跟随器：两级 RC 滤波器不再互相拖累
summary: RC 低通 → LM358 电压跟随器 → RC 高通。跟随器把两级隔开，中心频率处增益恢复成 0.707 × 0.707 = 0.5——和上一个实验的 1/3 对比。
concepts: 电压跟随器 voltage follower / buffer
输入阻抗高、输出阻抗低 high Z_in, low Z_out
级联网络函数相乘 H = H1·H2
description: **目标**：在上一个实验的两级之间加一个电压跟随器，消除负载效应，让带通的响应正好等于两级网络函数的乘积。
**电路**（LM358 用哪一半都行）：
- 电源：+9 V 接 8 脚 V+，GND 接 4 脚 V−。
- 第一级（低通）：信号发生器红夹子 → R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 A → C1（15 nF）→ GND。A 接运放 IN+。
- 跟随器：运放 OUT 直接连到 IN−（100% 负反馈，增益 1）。
- 第二级（高通）：OUT → C2（15 nF）→ 结点 VOUT → R2（10 kΩ）→ GND。
**信号发生器**：正弦波，幅度 1 V，**偏置 2 V**；频率依次 106 Hz、1061 Hz、10.6 kHz。**示波器**：CH1 接 VIN，CH2 接 VOUT；也可以把 CH2 挪到跟随器输出看第一级。
**为什么要偏置 2 V**：单电源 LM358 的输出只能在 0 ~ 7.5 V 之间。低通会把直流原样传过去，所以跟随器的输入在 1 ~ 3 V 之间摆动，输出也一样，不会碰到 0 V。第二级是高通，电容 C2 把 2 V 直流挡掉，VOUT 又回到以 0 V 为中心。
**先预测**：跟随器的输入几乎不取电流、输出阻抗很低，两级可以分开算、直接相乘。写出 H = H_LP · H_HP（令 x = f/f0），算三个频率下的 |H| 和相位、1061 Hz 时 VOUT 的 Vpp，并和上一个实验的 1/3 比较。
**测量**：三个频率下读 VOUT 相对 VIN 的幅度比和相位；把 CH2 挪到跟随器输出看第一级。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**一般规律**：多级电路之间加缓冲器（跟随器），是工程上“让各级各算各的”的标准做法；代价是需要给运放供电，并处理好直流偏置。

**真实电路里**：LM358 的输入共模范围从 0 V（V−）到约 V+ − 1.5 V（这里 7.5 V），跟随器输入 1 ~ 3 V 在范围内；输出上限约 7.5 V（仿真也有这个限制），输出靠近 0 V 时带负载能力变弱，所以 2 V 偏置让它远离 0 V 是对的。真实 LM358 的压摆率约 0.3–0.5 V/µs、增益带宽积约 1 MHz，仿真没有这两项限制；这里信号只有几伏、最高 10.6 kHz，最快变化最多约 0.07 V/µs，都在范围内；但 1 V 幅度的信号到约 50 kHz 以上就会受压摆率限制，跟随器跟不上了。

en.title: Experiment 4-8 · Add a voltage follower: two RC stages that no longer drag each other down
en.summary: RC low-pass → LM358 voltage follower → RC high-pass. The follower isolates the stages, so the gain at the centre frequency is back to 0.707 × 0.707 = 0.5 — compare with 1/3 in the previous experiment.
concepts: cascaded network functions multiply H = H1·H2
description: **Goal**: put a voltage follower between the two stages of the previous experiment, remove the loading effect, and get a band-pass whose response is exactly the product of the two stages' network functions.
**Circuit** (either half of the LM358):
- Power: +9 V to pin 8 (V+), GND to pin 4 (V−).
- Stage 1 (low-pass): generator red clip → R1 (10 kΩ) → node A → C1 (15 nF) → GND. A goes to the op-amp's IN+.
- Follower: the op-amp's OUT straight to IN− (100% negative feedback, gain 1).
- Stage 2 (high-pass): OUT → C2 (15 nF) → node VOUT → R2 (10 kΩ) → GND.
**Generator**: sine, amplitude 1 V, **offset 2 V**; frequency 106 Hz, 1061 Hz and 10.6 kHz in turn. **Scope**: CH1 on VIN, CH2 on VOUT; you can also move CH2 to the follower's output to see stage 1.

**Why the 2 V offset**: a single-supply LM358's output can only move between 0 and 7.5 V. The low-pass passes DC unchanged, so the follower's input — and its output — swings between 1 and 3 V and never hits 0 V. Stage 2 is a high-pass: C2 blocks the 2 V, and VOUT is centred on 0 V again.

**Predict first**: the follower's input draws almost no current and its output impedance is tiny, so the stages can be computed separately and multiplied. Write H = H_LP · H_HP (let x = f/f0), work out |H| and the phase at the three frequencies and VOUT's Vpp at 1061 Hz, and compare with the 1/3 of the previous experiment.

**Measure**: at each frequency read the amplitude ratio and phase of VOUT relative to VIN; move CH2 to the follower's output to see stage 1. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
**The general rule**: a buffer (follower) between stages is the standard engineering way to let each stage be designed on its own; the price is powering the op-amp and taking care of the DC bias.

**In a real circuit**: the LM358's input common-mode range runs from 0 V (V−) up to about V+ − 1.5 V (7.5 V here), so the follower's 1–3 V input is fine; its output tops out at about 7.5 V (the simulator models this) and gets weak at driving a load near 0 V, so the 2 V bias keeping it away from 0 V is the right call. A real LM358's slew rate (about 0.3–0.5 V/µs) and gain-bandwidth product (about 1 MHz) are not simulated; with a few volts at up to 10.6 kHz the fastest change here is at most about 0.07 V/µs, within limits; but a 1 V-amplitude signal above roughly 50 kHz would be slew-limited and the follower could no longer keep up.
compare: - **1061 Hz**: the follower's output is 0.707∠−45°, VOUT = 0.707 × 0.707 = **0.5**∠0° (only 1/3 without the follower in the previous experiment). VOUT ≈ 1.0 Vpp.

Notice the denominator changed from "1 − x² + 3jx" to "(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx": the missing jx is the loading effect. The follower's very high input impedance means node A doesn't feel stage 2 at all; its tiny output impedance (about 10 Ω) means stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 on the follower output, amplitude ratio OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: The follower draws almost no current, so stage 1 is an unloaded RC low-pass: 0.707∠−45° at f0.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 back on VOUT, amplitude ratio VOUT/VIN
From your two readings, the gain of stage 2 (the high-pass) on its own = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707, exactly an unloaded RC high-pass at f0: the follower's output impedance is tiny, so stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source and the stages simply multiply.

measurements.ask: Multimeter DC range: the follower OUT to GND, the average
measurements.explain: The low-pass passes the 2 V offset unchanged, so the follower swings between 1 and 3 V, averaging 2 V; C2 then blocks it and VOUT averages 0.
H = jx/(1 + jx)², x = 0.1: |H| = 0.1/1.01 ≈ 0.099, phase ≈ +78.6° (0.097 and +73° without the follower).

hints: Power first: pin 8 to +9 V, pin 4 to GND; the follower is just a wire from OUT to IN−.
Stage 1 is R1 then C1 to GND, with its middle on IN+; stage 2 is C2 then R2 to GND, driven from OUT.
Keep the generator offset at 2 V so the follower never has to go below 0 V.
tests: 1061 Hz: VOUT is the product of the two network functions, phase 0°
1061 Hz: the follower output carries the DC offset, VOUT does not (C2 blocks it)

tests.name: 1061 Hz：VOUT 等于两级网络函数的乘积，相位 0°
1061 Hz：跟随器输出带着直流偏置，VOUT 没有（C2 隔直）

compare: 注意分母从“1 − x² + 3jx”变成了“(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx”：少掉的那个 jx 就是负载效应。跟随器的输入阻抗极高，第一级的 A 点不受第二级影响；输出阻抗很低（约 10 Ω），第二级看到的是一个“理想电压源”。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 挪到跟随器输出，幅度比 OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: 跟随器几乎不取电流，第一级是不带负载的 RC 低通：在 f0 处 0.707∠−45°。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 回到 VOUT，幅度比 VOUT/VIN
用你的两个读数算第二级（高通）单独的增益 = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707，正是一个不带负载的 RC 高通在 f0 处的值：跟随器的输出阻抗很低，第二级看到的是理想电压源，两级各算各的、直接相乘。

measurements.ask: 万用表直流档：跟随器 OUT 对 GND 的平均电压
measurements.explain: 低通把 2 V 偏置原样传过去，跟随器输出在 1 ~ 3 V 之间摆动，平均 2 V；C2 再把它挡掉，VOUT 的平均是 0。

hints: 先供电：8 脚 +9 V，4 脚 GND；跟随器就是一根从 OUT 到 IN− 的线。
第一级：R1 再 C1 到 GND，中点接 IN+；第二级：从 OUT 出发，C2 再 R2 到 GND。
信号发生器偏置保持 2 V，跟随器就不用输出低于 0 V 的电压。
